description: This file defines functions and types for managing browser profiles and contexts, including creating profile-specific contexts, listing profiles, and handling browser operations within a server environment.

methods.name: listKnownProfileNames
methods.description: Returns a list of all known profile names from the server state.

methods.name: createProfileContext
methods.description: Creates a profile-scoped context for browser operations, including tab management and browser availability.

methods.name: createBrowserRouteContext
methods.description: Creates a route context for managing browser profiles and operations, including listing profiles and handling errors.
